title: Ruth and Naomi
description: After Naomi loses her husband and sons in Moab, she returns to Bethlehem. Her daughter-in-law Ruth refuses to leave her, saying: 'Your people shall be my people, and your God my God.'

versions.title: Ruth and Naomi
versions.description: Ruth refuses to leave her mother-in-law Naomi and follows her back to Bethlehem with the words: 'Your people shall be my people.'
versions.reason: [major] category: Although the story begins 'in the days when the judges ruled', the book of Ruth is traditionally dated to the period of the judges, so 'judges' is acceptable. No change needed.
